articles.title: How the Red Sox missed out on superstar center fielder Pete Crow-Armstrong in the 2020 draft
articles.description: Crow-Armstrong was on the board for the Red Sox at pick No. 17, but Boston drafted Nick Yorke in that spot instead.

articles.title: Which version of the Red Sox can we expect to show up in the playoffs? And other thoughts.
articles.description: Red Sox-Yankees is shaping up as a pitchers’ duel, especially now that it looks like Aaron Judge (calf strain) is out.

articles.title: Red Sox bats go quiet once again as Guardians clinch playoff spot
articles.description: The loss dropped the Red Sox to 85-74 and — with three games to go — ensured that they will not match their 89 wins from last year.

articles.title: Red Sox hoping investment in Ranger Suarez pays off in the postseason
articles.description: The Red Sox were 17-11 in games in which the lefthander started this season. Can the success continue in the playoffs?

articles.title: Willson Contreras frustrated bruised right hand is not allowing him to swing the bat regularly
articles.description: Contreras took BP on the field for upwards of 20 minutes on Tuesday — and said then that it went only “OK” — and apparently regressed in the days after.

articles.title: Pedro Martinez on Game 7 in 2003, no regrets on calling the Yankees his daddies, and a mission to help
articles.description: Martinez is in town to help launch an after-school program in Lawrence, one of the many ways he tries to help kids who remind him of himself in the Dominican Republic.

articles.title: Game 159: Guardians at Red Sox lineups and notes
articles.description: Ranger Suarez will make his final start of the season, opposing Daniel Espino and the Guardians.

articles.title: Sonny Gray’s doubters always said he wasn’t cut out for a big market. This season, he proved them wrong.
articles.description: Gray is lined up to start in next week’s Wild Card Series, likely in New York against the Yankees – affording him one more opportunity to dispel a narrative.

articles.title: Ceddanne Rafaela to undergo MRI after early exit with right hamstring tightness
articles.description: Rafaela caught all three Guardians batted balls in the first inning, laced a single in the second inning and departed in the top of the third.

articles.title: Red Sox eke out a win over Guardians with pitching formula they hope to employ in the playoffs
articles.description: Sonny Gray (18th win), Aroldis Chapman (35th save) and Jarren Duran (2 for 3, 20th stolen base) deliver in a 1-0 victory over the Guardians.

articles.title: Red Sox and Cubs to play doubleheader Friday ahead of rainy weekend
articles.description: Saturday's game could also be moved up if it helps the two teams play this series before the end of the regular season.

articles.title: How MLB’s potential work stoppage can impact one of the Red Sox’ top prospects
articles.description: As a player in his third pro season, Franklin Arias isn’t on the 40-man roster. He doesn’t have to be added to it until after the 2027 season.

articles.title: Game 158: Guardians at Red Sox lineups and notes
articles.description: Sonny Gray will be on the mound when the Red Sox look to snap a three-game losing streak against Cleveland.

articles.title: ‘It’s a lot over there’: Marcelo Mayer and his father sound off on Red Sox tenure, trade to Giants
articles.description: "In Boston, if you’re going well, you’re a god and if you’re struggling, they’re going to tear you apart," said Marcelo Mayer's father, Enrique.

articles.title: Postseason secured, but Red Sox trending in wrong direction and Guardians take advantage to open series
articles.description: Reliever Erik Miller struggled again in taking the loss and the offense remained at a minimum. Pinch hitter Mickey Gasper’s tying homer in the eighth inning went for naught.

articles.title: Garrett Crochet steps up mound work by facing a hitter, ‘definitely making progress’ toward Red Sox return
articles.description: Crochet (shoulder) threw live batting practice to fellow Red Sox rehabber Ceddanne Rafaela prior to the series opener vs. the Guardians.
